One simple dry skull, two dark eye sockets, CLOSED blunt jaw with three broad teeth marks at most. No flesh, blood or graphic injury, no exposed organ, human face, armor suit, weapon, crown or regalia.
One complete nearly frontal slight-overhead static figure, all extremities in generous genuinely ALPHA transparent margins. Native body64px high, at most52px wide on a64px-per-cell reference.
